answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit of saffron-token credits to register, and each identity must solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its public key. A sock-puppet attacker forging N identities must post N deposits plus burn compute per key, while honest agents recover stakes on exit. Reputation acts as an onyx ledger of verified work, immutable and costly to fake, and every new agent is checked against a mirror registry of prior keys, so duplicated or cloned identities are rejected before they earn.
